description.en: During a match, resets the current action of a player on the pitch (clears its action state). The player is given by parameter ID (searched among all the pitch slots) or by pitch slot number; the team only has to be 0 or 1 for anything to happen. The match script that uses it first tests that the command exists.
Parameter ID (e.g. "para_cp0131") or pitch slot number.

examples.case: After giving the ball to a player (real usage, from btl0006.nut; the decompiled file shows the existence test as $[stack offset 0]; it is written here with getroottable(), the form ev42019001.nut shows)
